title: Bram and the Ghost
author: Odile Quintana
blurb: Orsen Vasquez, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
